{{Quote|Meedee-one, please analyze the maps. Find any profile that matches a ''Pythar''-class Imperial shuttlecraft.|Leeha Narezz|<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />}}
The '''''Pythar''-class Imperial shuttlecraft''' was a type of [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. ''Pythar''-class shuttles were small [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] with short, curved wings on either side. A ''Pythar''-class shuttlecraft named the ''[[Deference]]'' was utilized by an [[Unidentified Imperial scientist|Imperial scientist]] during the war when he performed upgrades on the [[Emperor's Fortress|personal space station]] of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. The ''Deference'' was shot down in the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" /> in [[3665 BBY]],<ref name="Gnost">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref> and the shuttle later became the target of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mission to Hoth (Hunt for the Sith Emperor)|mission]] to retrieve the plans for the Emperor's [[Space station/Legends|space station]] stored within the ship's [[Computer/Legends|computers]].<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Pythar''-class shuttlecraft was first mentioned by the Jedi [[Leeha Narezz]] in the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class mission "Sub-Zero Showdown" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], where locating the shuttle ''Deference'' is the objective of the player's mission.<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" /> Another shuttle appears in the game's first digital expansion, [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']].<ref name="Rise">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>
